aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.caption: Web Designer & Front-End Developer
aboutMe.description: I am a front-end designer and developer focused on creating attractive, fast, and user-friendly interfaces. My main passion is turning ideas and designs into interactive and dynamic web experiences. When designing websites, I pay close attention not only to visual aesthetics but also to user experience (UX), performance, and accessibility. I have strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frameworks such as React, and I always strive to write clean, scalable, and standards-compliant code. Responsive design and cross-browser compatibility are among my top priorities. Continuous learning of new web technologies and keeping up with design trends are some of my key strengths. I enjoy teamwork, solving technical challenges, and turning clients' requirements into practical and professional products. My goal is to build websites that are both beautiful and effective.

services.title: Services
services.caption: Professional web design and front-end development services tailored to your needs.

webDevelopment.title: Web Design & Development
webDevelopment.description: Designing and building websites from scratch based on your business needs and goals. The focus is on a modern appearance, well-structured layouts, and a smooth user experience. Websites are developed responsively for mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.

frontend.title: Front-End Development
frontend.description: Building the visual and interactive parts of websites using modern technologies. Clean code, scalable architecture, and attention to UI details are at the core of every project. The goal is to create a fast, smooth, and device-friendly experience.

pageDesign.title: Page Design & Implementation
pageDesign.description: Turning your ideas, wireframes, or design files into real, functional web pages. Every visual detail is carefully implemented and optimized to display properly across different screen sizes.

reactNext.title: React & Next.js Development
reactNext.description: Building modern websites and user interfaces with React and Next.js. Organized and scalable structures are used for both small and large projects, with a focus on performance, speed, and a better web experience.

bugFixing.title: Bug Fixing & Optimization
bugFixing.description: Identifying and fixing visual and technical front-end issues. Improving speed, performance, responsiveness, and code structure when needed. The goal is to turn a problematic website into a smoother and more stable experience for users.

fullProject.title: Complete Project Development
fullProject.description: If your project requires multiple specialists, I can coordinate the different parts of the project. The front-end development is handled by me, while I collaborate with the appropriate specialists for other areas.
